8120d026f1f7: BENIGN Rifaien self-submission agent, UPX-packed x86 PE.
Recovered main at 0x4013a0 obtains its own module filename, reads the image,
locates [[UNIQUE]], seeds a PRNG, chooses a node, randomizes sixteen bytes,
writes a clone, constructs file[]/node/submit multipart fields, posts the
clone with libcurl, removes it, and repeats after a thirty-second sleep.
The UPX stub can be emulated to recover this code despite its stale checksum.
No supported credential theft, mining or ransomware claim was found.
Remaining blocker: engine-generated anti-static/packer/upx/decompression-failed
is hostile. pe.rs hardcodes that severity; YAML cannot suppress this finding.

86478a6af173: MALICIOUS concealed LookFor GUI loader, x86 PE.
Version information claims LookFor 2.0.1.7, Sanny Ltd. It is not evidence of
CryptoLocker identity. The window procedure uses WM_COMMAND as dispatch,
manually resolves exports by a 64-KiB module backscan, allocates a buffer,
changes it to executable protection, and invokes an opaque global pointer.
0x40113a reconstructs disjoint fragments and filters a byte dictionary;
0x40359e invokes the global pointer. GUI initialization must be considered
when recovering the relocated fragment tables. Partial emulation recovered
3351 filtered bytes, but did not establish the final payload's role.
A dominant overlay contains unrelated sandbox executable-path corpus and
Oracle prose. Three suspicious traits describe the supported concealment;
no malware-family or ransomware verdict is inferred from the feed labels.

67b767d6a2fa: MALICIOUS native x64 HTTP inbox command implant.
0x14000f140 posts JSON heartbeat data, lists inbox files, fetches task JSON,
dispatches ping/exec/sleep/fetch/uninstall, and removes consumed inbox files.
The exec handler selects the cmd field and invokes a shell execution helper.
0x140015640 prepares CommandLineTemplate and creates a CommandLineEventConsumer
through 0x140019d50. Separate routines create timer/filter/binding objects.
Registry Run, scheduled-task, COM and process-memory APIs also occur; the
new verdicts do not infer all these actions from imports alone.
C2 and WMI composites have test-rules precision 8.5 and 9.0 respectively.
Removing the heartbeat disables both. Removing the binding class disables
WMI persistence while retaining C2. Removing the GUI invocation disables
both fragment-loader composites. Native HttpClient prose no longer matches
.NET identity; qualified System.Net.Http.HttpClient remains detected.

Placement corrections preserve matcher scope except where recorded:
- GUI global-pointer invocation: process/create/loader -> control-flow/dispatch.
- Command-field table indexing: dispatch -> property/access; consumer updated.
- Session URI encoding: URL query -> data/encode/url; consumer updated.
- WinHTTP/temp/write API cluster: neutral communications capability, not dropper.
- Sandbox-path corpus: filesystem paths -> anti-static string junking; additionally
  require a dominant overlay and many executable paths to support padding.
- Remove two unsupported hostile API co-occurrence verdicts. Their atomic API
  observations remain; precise remote tasking/persistence verdicts replace them.
- Noncertificate overlay wording no longer implies a signature exists.
All exact consumers and ancestor directory selectors were audited. No current
external mapping references these changed IDs. Existing leaf boundaries are used.
